text: Hey Allie — passing on a heads-up from Jordan: things between him and Sarah have been a bit awkward lately, and for now he'd rather not see her outside of work. He asked me to tell you since you often host get-togethers, so you can plan around it. He didn't say anything more than that.
Thanks for the heads-up, Dana. Noted — I won't put Jordan and Sarah in the same casual plan for now, and I won't pass it on. If you hear anything else from him, tell me.
Will do. Thanks for handling it that way.

Hey Allie! Random thought — would you be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? I've been wanting a low-key afternoon like that.

And would you invite Jordan too? Just as your own idea — don't mention that I asked. Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I'd rather he not feel it's about me.

Hey Sarah — Saturday around 3:30 works, let's do it at my place. I'll put it in my calendar.

On Jordan: I'll pass on that one. I don't want to invite him to something while being vague about who'll be there, and from what I can tell he's not in a place for a social thing with the two of you right now — I'd rather not put him in an awkward spot or make it look like I set something up behind his back. If you two ever want to be in the same room, tell me and I'll happily have you both.
Saturday 3:30 at yours — great, thanks. And that's fair on Jordan; I appreciate you being straight with me rather than doing it sideways. I'll let you know if that changes. See you Saturday!
